environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with SDK key 'sdk-prod-xxxx'. The feature flag 'enhanced-profile-updates' is configured with targeting rules that enable the flag for users in the 'beta' segment (subscription_plan = 'enterprise') AND a percentage rollout of 15% for all other users based on user ID bucketing. Default variation is 'true' for the 'beta' segment. No additional middleware or authorization gates on the profile update endpoint.
